name: HCKK Ventures Limited
about: HCKK Ventures Limited offers technology consultancy and technology-enabled solutions in the telecommunication, logistics, and education sectors in India. The company offers software and digital solutions to enhance regulatory compliance in domains, such as e-invoicing, e-way bill, goods and services tax, and digital certificates. In addition, the company implements enterprise resource planning systems for integrating logistics, freight forwarding, warehousing, and transportation. The company was formerly known as Shreenath Industrial Investment Company Limited and changed its name to HCKK Ventures Limited in January 2017. HCKK Ventures Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Nashik, India.
